cases.name: native-unit-declarations-parameters-if-while-with
cases.source:
UBE SOURCE 1 MODULE
Attribute UBE_Name = "Complex"
Const Limit As Long = 3
Sub Work(ByVal InputValue As Long)
    Dim Count As Long = InputValue
    If Count < Limit Then
        While Count < Limit
            Count = Count + 1
        Wend
    Else
        With InputValue
            Print .Value
        End With
    End If
End Sub
